patch_description: Runs the full greedy + move + swap local-search pipeline under 4 different greedy orderings (r/s with size tiebreak, r/s only, model_size only, density r/(s·size)) and returns the placement with the lowest max KVPR. The swap phase (exchange models between the worst GPU and other GPUs) is the biggest additional gain beyond moves; multi-start over orderings guards against bad greedy seeds.
